summary: End-to-end frontend testing of KDPLUS Purchase Order editing + enhanced receiving workflow. Owner login OK. All 15 UI assertions passed: PO list shows friendly status labels (Draft/Sent/Partially Received/Received/Closed – Partially Received); created a new PO as Draft; edited Draft PO (qty 10->15, cost 20->25) and change persisted after reopen; Mark Sent transitions status to Sent and Edit button correctly disappears; Receive panel over-receipt is blocked client-side (999 vs outstanding 15); +20% variance surfaces red variance amount/%, amber warning appears, submit is blocked without a reason; submit succeeds with reason 'Supplier price increase' + LOT-TEST-A, status becomes Partially Received; Receipt History renders with date/product/qty/PO cost/actual/variance amt+%/lot/user and includes the variance reason; Cancel Remaining (confirm accepted) transitions status to 'Closed – Partially Received'. Backend was already curl-verified by main agent (weighted avg, latest_cost, movement, lot cost, 400s for over-outstanding and missing reason); UI faithfully calls those endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: PurchaseOrders.jsx is 391 lines with 4 components + printPO in one file — acceptable now but consider splitting POForm/POView/ReceivePanel/printPO for maintainability if it grows.
ReceivePanel.calc recomputes on every keystroke; fine for small POs, but memoize per-row if lines get large.
cancelRemaining uses window.confirm — consistent but not styled; a shadcn AlertDialog would match the rest of the UI.
recv-qty input allows negative values via type=number (min not set); server rejects but front-end could add min=0 for better UX.
seed_data_creation: Created PO-20260911-00005 (AMOXICILLIN 100MG DROPS, 15 @ P25.00) with LOT-TEST-A, received 5 @ P30.00 with variance reason 'Supplier price increase', then cancelled remaining 10 -> status CLOSED_PARTIAL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Purchase Orders module (create/edit/send/receive/cancel-remaining/print + variance workflow) is fully working end-to-end on preview URL. Cookies are httpOnly so playwright login via email form works; product ids can be extracted from data-testid=recv-qty-{pid}. Draft PO row filter via '.text contains Draft' works in the current list. If retesting, note that PO numbers auto-increment per day (PO-YYYYMMDD-#####).
